bubble.code: void bubbleSort(vector<int>& arr) { {{NEWLINE}}    int n = arr.size();{{NEWLINE}}    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { {{NEWLINE}}        bool swapped = false;{{NEWLINE}}        for (int j = 0; j < n - i - 1; j++) { {{NEWLINE}}            if (arr[j] > arr[j + 1]) { {{NEWLINE}}                int temp = arr[j + 1];{{NEWLINE}}                arr[j + 1] = arr[j];{{NEWLINE}}                arr[j] = temp;{{NEWLINE}}                swapped = true;{{NEWLINE}}            }{{NEWLINE}}        }{{NEWLINE}}        if (!swapped) break;{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}}

selection.code: void selectionSort(vector<int>& arr) { {{NEWLINE}}    int arr_size = arr.size();{{NEWLINE}}    for (int i = 0; i <= arr_size - 2; i++) { {{NEWLINE}}        int min_idx = i;{{NEWLINE}}        for (int j = i + 1; j < arr_size; j++) { {{NEWLINE}}            if (arr[j] < arr[min_idx]) min_idx = j;{{NEWLINE}}        }{{NEWLINE}}        int temp = arr[i];{{NEWLINE}}        arr[i] = arr[min_idx];{{NEWLINE}}        arr[min_idx] = temp;{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}    return;{{NEWLINE}}}

insertion.code: void insertionSort(vector<int>& arr) { {{NEWLINE}}    int n = arr.size();{{NEWLINE}}    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) { {{NEWLINE}}        int key = arr[i];{{NEWLINE}}        int j = i - 1;{{NEWLINE}}        while (j >= 0 && arr[j] > key) { {{NEWLINE}}            arr[j + 1] = arr[j];{{NEWLINE}}            j = j - 1;{{NEWLINE}}        }{{NEWLINE}}        arr[j + 1] = key;{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}}

merge.code: void merge(vector<int>& arr, int left, int mid, int right) { {{NEWLINE}}    int n1 = mid - left + 1;{{NEWLINE}}    int n2 = right - mid;{{NEWLINE}}{{NEWLINE}}    vector<int> leftArr(n1);{{NEWLINE}}    vector<int> rightArr(n2);{{NEWLINE}}{{NEWLINE}}    for (int i = 0; i < n1; i++){{NEWLINE}}        leftArr[i] = arr[left + i];{{NEWLINE}}    for (int j = 0; j < n2; j++){{NEWLINE}}        rightArr[j] = arr[mid + 1 + j];{{NEWLINE}}{{NEWLINE}}    int i = 0, j = 0, k = left;{{NEWLINE}}    while (i < n1 && j < n2) { {{NEWLINE}}        if (leftArr[i] <= rightArr[j]) { {{NEWLINE}}            arr[k] = leftArr[i];{{NEWLINE}}            i++;{{NEWLINE}}        } else { {{NEWLINE}}            arr[k] = rightArr[j];{{NEWLINE}}            j++;{{NEWLINE}}        }{{NEWLINE}}        k++;{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}{{NEWLINE}}    while (i < n1) { {{NEWLINE}}        arr[k] = leftArr[i];{{NEWLINE}}        i++;{{NEWLINE}}        k++;{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}{{NEWLINE}}    while (j < n2) { {{NEWLINE}}        arr[k] = rightArr[j];{{NEWLINE}}        j++;{{NEWLINE}}        k++;{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}}{{NEWLINE}}{{NEWLINE}}void mergeSortHelper(vector<int>& arr, int left, int right) { {{NEWLINE}}    if (left < right) { {{NEWLINE}}        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;{{NEWLINE}}        mergeSortHelper(arr, left, mid);{{NEWLINE}}        mergeSortHelper(arr, mid + 1, right);{{NEWLINE}}        merge(arr, left, mid, right);{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}}{{NEWLINE}}{{NEWLINE}}void mergeSort(vector<int>& arr) { {{NEWLINE}}    mergeSortHelper(arr, 0, arr.size() - 1);{{NEWLINE}}}

quick.complexity: Best & Average Case O(n log n), Worst Case O(n^2)
quick.code: int partition(vector<int>& arr, int low, int high) { {{NEWLINE}}    int pivot = arr[high];{{NEWLINE}}    int i = low - 1;{{NEWLINE}}    for (int j = low; j < high; j++) { {{NEWLINE}}        if (arr[j] < pivot) { {{NEWLINE}}            i++;{{NEWLINE}}            swap(arr[i], arr[j]);{{NEWLINE}}        }{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}    swap(arr[i + 1], arr[high]);{{NEWLINE}}    return i + 1;{{NEWLINE}}}{{NEWLINE}}{{NEWLINE}}void quickSort(vector<int>& arr, int low = 0, int high = -1) { {{NEWLINE}}    if (high == -1) high = arr.size() - 1;{{NEWLINE}}    if (low < high) { {{NEWLINE}}        int pi = partition(arr, low, high);{{NEWLINE}}        quickSort(arr, low, pi - 1);{{NEWLINE}}        quickSort(arr, pi + 1, high);{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}}

heap.complexity: Best & Average & Worst Case O(n log n)
heap.code: void heapify(vector<int>& arr, int n, int i) { {{NEWLINE}}    int largest = i;{{NEWLINE}}    int left = 2 * i + 1;{{NEWLINE}}    int right = 2 * i + 2;{{NEWLINE}}    if (left < n && arr[left] > arr[largest]) largest = left;{{NEWLINE}}    if (right < n && arr[right] > arr[largest]) largest = right;{{NEWLINE}}    if (largest != i) { {{NEWLINE}}        swap(arr[i], arr[largest]);{{NEWLINE}}        heapify(arr, n, largest);{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}}{{NEWLINE}}{{NEWLINE}}void heapSort(vector<int>& arr) { {{NEWLINE}}    int n = arr.size();{{NEWLINE}}    for (int i = n / 2 - 1; i >= 0; i--) heapify(arr, n, i);{{NEWLINE}}    for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) { {{NEWLINE}}        swap(arr[0], arr[i]);{{NEWLINE}}        heapify(arr, i, 0);{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}}

shell.complexity: Best Case O(n log n), Worst Case O(n^2)
shell.code: void shellSort(vector<int>& arr) { {{NEWLINE}}    int n = arr.size();{{NEWLINE}}    for (int gap = n / 2; gap > 0; gap /= 2) { {{NEWLINE}}        for (int i = gap; i < n; i++) { {{NEWLINE}}            int temp = arr[i];{{NEWLINE}}            int j = i;{{NEWLINE}}            while (j >= gap && arr[j - gap] > temp) { {{NEWLINE}}                arr[j] = arr[j - gap];{{NEWLINE}}                j -= gap;{{NEWLINE}}            }{{NEWLINE}}            arr[j] = temp;{{NEWLINE}}        }{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}}

cocktail.code: void cocktailSort(vector<int>& arr) { {{NEWLINE}}    int start = 0;{{NEWLINE}}    int end = arr.size() - 1;{{NEWLINE}}    bool swapped = true;{{NEWLINE}}    while (swapped) { {{NEWLINE}}        swapped = false;{{NEWLINE}}        for (int i = start; i < end; i++) { {{NEWLINE}}            if (arr[i] > arr[i + 1]) { {{NEWLINE}}                swap(arr[i], arr[i + 1]);{{NEWLINE}}                swapped = true;{{NEWLINE}}            }{{NEWLINE}}        }{{NEWLINE}}        if (!swapped) break;{{NEWLINE}}        swapped = false;{{NEWLINE}}        end--;{{NEWLINE}}        for (int i = end - 1; i >= start; i--) { {{NEWLINE}}            if (arr[i] > arr[i + 1]) { {{NEWLINE}}                swap(arr[i], arr[i + 1]);{{NEWLINE}}                swapped = true;{{NEWLINE}}            }{{NEWLINE}}        }{{NEWLINE}}        start++;{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}}

gnome.code: void gnomeSort(vector<int>& arr) { {{NEWLINE}}    int i = 0;{{NEWLINE}}    while (i < arr.size()) { {{NEWLINE}}        if (i == 0 || arr[i] >= arr[i - 1]) { {{NEWLINE}}            i++;{{NEWLINE}}        } else { {{NEWLINE}}            swap(arr[i], arr[i - 1]);{{NEWLINE}}            i--;{{NEWLINE}}        }{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}}

counting.complexity: Best & Average & Worst Case O(n + k)
counting.code: void countingSort(vector<int>& arr) { {{NEWLINE}}    if (arr.empty()) return;{{NEWLINE}}    int minVal = *min_element(arr.begin(), arr.end());{{NEWLINE}}    int maxVal = *max_element(arr.begin(), arr.end());{{NEWLINE}}    vector<int> count(maxVal - minVal + 1, 0);{{NEWLINE}}    for (int v : arr) count[v - minVal]++;{{NEWLINE}}    int idx = 0;{{NEWLINE}}    for (int v = minVal; v <= maxVal; v++) { {{NEWLINE}}        while (count[v - minVal]-- > 0) arr[idx++] = v;{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}}

comb.complexity: Best Case O(n log n), Worst Case O(n^2)
comb.code: void combSort(vector<int>& arr) { {{NEWLINE}}    int n = arr.size();{{NEWLINE}}    int gap = n;{{NEWLINE}}    bool swapped = true;{{NEWLINE}}    while (gap > 1 || swapped) { {{NEWLINE}}        gap = max(1, gap * 10 / 13);{{NEWLINE}}        swapped = false;{{NEWLINE}}        for (int i = 0; i + gap < n; i++) { {{NEWLINE}}            if (arr[i] > arr[i + gap]) { {{NEWLINE}}                swap(arr[i], arr[i + gap]);{{NEWLINE}}                swapped = true;{{NEWLINE}}            }{{NEWLINE}}        }{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}}

oddeven.code: void oddEvenSort(vector<int>& arr) { {{NEWLINE}}    int n = arr.size();{{NEWLINE}}    bool sorted = false;{{NEWLINE}}    while (!sorted) { {{NEWLINE}}        sorted = true;{{NEWLINE}}        for (int i = 1; i < n - 1; i += 2) { {{NEWLINE}}            if (arr[i] > arr[i + 1]) { {{NEWLINE}}                swap(arr[i], arr[i + 1]);{{NEWLINE}}                sorted = false;{{NEWLINE}}            }{{NEWLINE}}        }{{NEWLINE}}        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i += 2) { {{NEWLINE}}            if (arr[i] > arr[i + 1]) { {{NEWLINE}}                swap(arr[i], arr[i + 1]);{{NEWLINE}}                sorted = false;{{NEWLINE}}            }{{NEWLINE}}        }{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}}

radix.complexity: Best & Average & Worst Case O(d * (n + b))
radix.code: void radixSort(vector<int>& arr) { {{NEWLINE}}    if (arr.empty()) return;{{NEWLINE}}    int minVal = *min_element(arr.begin(), arr.end());{{NEWLINE}}    vector<int> work(arr.size());{{NEWLINE}}    for (int i = 0; i < arr.size(); i++) work[i] = arr[i] - minVal;{{NEWLINE}}    int maxVal = *max_element(work.begin(), work.end());{{NEWLINE}}    vector<int> buffer(arr.size());{{NEWLINE}}    for (int exp = 1; maxVal / exp > 0; exp *= 10) { {{NEWLINE}}        vector<int> count(10, 0);{{NEWLINE}}        for (int v : work) count[(v / exp) % 10]++;{{NEWLINE}}        for (int i = 1; i < 10; i++) count[i] += count[i - 1];{{NEWLINE}}        for (int i = work.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) { {{NEWLINE}}            int digit = (work[i] / exp) % 10;{{NEWLINE}}            buffer[--count[digit]] = work[i];{{NEWLINE}}        }{{NEWLINE}}        work = buffer;{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}    for (int i = 0; i < arr.size(); i++) arr[i] = work[i] + minVal;{{NEWLINE}}}

bucket.complexity: Best & Average Case O(n + k), Worst Case O(n^2)
bucket.code: void bucketSort(vector<int>& arr) { {{NEWLINE}}    if (arr.empty()) return;{{NEWLINE}}    int minVal = *min_element(arr.begin(), arr.end());{{NEWLINE}}    int maxVal = *max_element(arr.begin(), arr.end());{{NEWLINE}}    int n = arr.size();{{NEWLINE}}    int span = maxVal - minVal + 1;{{NEWLINE}}    vector<vector<int>> buckets(n);{{NEWLINE}}    for (int v : arr) { {{NEWLINE}}        int idx = (v - minVal) * n / span;{{NEWLINE}}        if (idx >= n) idx = n - 1;{{NEWLINE}}        buckets[idx].push_back(v);{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}    int k = 0;{{NEWLINE}}    for (auto& bucket : buckets) { {{NEWLINE}}        sort(bucket.begin(), bucket.end());{{NEWLINE}}        for (int v : bucket) arr[k++] = v;{{NEWLINE}}    }{{NEWLINE}}}
